title: Scouting the Dynamics Gap: Test-Time Policy Adaptation via Action-Outcome Feedback
description:
arXiv:2609.36107v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: While pretrained robotic policies exhibit impressive capabilities in controlled environments, unobserved physical properties and dynamics require these policies to rapidly adapt during deployment. Existing test-time adaptation methods typically rely on sparse scalar rewards, failing to exploit the rich geometric and dynamic feedback from the environment during physical interaction.
